payout_quote: After their account is opened, we will credit you and your friend's checking account with $50 each!
steps: Complete the referral form with your name and address and give it to a friend
Friend presents the form when opening and funding a new 1st Step, 1st Gold, or 1st Classic Checking account
Friend's account stays active and in good standing with no monthly maintenance fees for the first two statement cycles
$50 credited to each party's 1st Security Bank account within 90 days of the referred account opening
catches: Friend must be new to 1st Security Bank (no account relationship within the past 12 months)
Referral form must be presented at account opening
Account must be active and in good standing with no monthly maintenance service charges for the first two statement cycles
Referring customer cannot be an owner or beneficiary of the referred account
Referral bonus arrives up to 90 days after account opening
No referral cap stated on the flyer
biggest_catch: Your $50 takes up to 90 days to arrive, and your friend must be genuinely new to 1st Security Bank.
eligibility: 1st Security Bank customers; referred friends must be new to the bank (no relationship within 12 months)
timing: Within 90 days of the referred checking account opening date
